+def transform(grid):
+    """Project centered 3x3 markers along the repeated 2-lines."""
+    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
+    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
+
+    # The 2s form one family of parallel rails, with a marker occasionally
+    # replacing rail cells by 3s. Choose the family with the strongest rails.
+    row_scores = [sum(v == 2 for v in row) for row in grid]
+    col_scores = [sum(grid[r][c] == 2 for r in range(h)) for c in range(w)]
+    row_rails = [r for r, n in enumerate(row_scores) if n >= max(3, w // 2)]
+    col_rails = [c for c, n in enumerate(col_scores) if n >= max(3, h // 2)]
+    vertical_rails = bool(col_rails) and (not row_rails or max(col_scores) / h > max(row_scores) / w)
+    rails = col_rails if vertical_rails else row_rails
+
+    # Find 3x3 frames (3 perimeter, 2 center) whose center lies on a rail.
+    markers = []
+    for r in range(1, h - 1):
+        for c in range(1, w - 1):
+            if (c if vertical_rails else r) not in rails or grid[r][c] != 2:
+                continue
+            if all(grid[rr][cc] == 3
+                   for rr in range(r - 1, r + 2)
+                   for cc in range(c - 1, c + 2)
+                   if (rr, cc) != (r, c)):
+                markers.append((r, c))
+
+    # Extend the center row/column through open cells, and reproduce the
+    # frame in color 1 at each other parallel rail.
+    for r, c in markers:
+        if vertical_rails:
+            for cc in range(w):
+                if out[r][cc] == 0:
+                    out[r][cc] = 1
+            targets = [(r, rail) for rail in rails if rail != c]
+        else:
+            for rr in range(h):
+                if out[rr][c] == 0:
+                    out[rr][c] = 1
+            targets = [(rail, c) for rail in rails if rail != r]
+        for tr, tc in targets:
+            for rr in range(max(0, tr - 1), min(h, tr + 2)):
+                for cc in range(max(0, tc - 1), min(w, tc + 2)):
+                    if (rr, cc) != (tr, tc) and out[rr][cc] == 0:
+                        out[rr][cc] = 1
+    return out
*** End Patch
